gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Total Governmental Funds) total revenues 455,042; detail revenue lines (budget-and-actual schedules pp8-11 plus the Park donation 1,800 taken from p4) total 456,521, 1,479 above. The budgetary-basis schedules print 2 amounts that differ from the p4 fund columns: (1) General Fund budget schedule p8 Miscellaneous 11,881 (detail index 9) vs p4 General column Miscellaneous 10,825 = 1,056 (p8 amounts available 363,354 - fund balance 35,076 = 328,278 vs p4 General total revenues 327,222, difference 1,056); (2) Debt Service Fund budget schedule p11 Property taxes 25,043 (detail index 28) vs p4 Debt Service column Property taxes 24,620 = 423 (p11 resources printed 25,110 vs p4 Debt Service total revenues 24,687). 1,056 + 423 = 1,479. Both schedule amounts are printed on the budgetary basis and really differ from the statement; no detail fix.

Statement p4 Interfund transfer in: General 143,533, Street 70,848, Park 54,327, Debt Service 16,974, Total 285,682. Detail transfers in total 158,760 = General 16,611 (index 13) + Street 70,848 (index 21) + Park 54,327 (index 26) + Debt Service 16,974 (index 33). The General Fund budget schedule p8 prints only the net Interfund transfers (16,611) = p4 General transfer in 143,533 - transfer out 126,922. Gap 285,682 - 158,760 = 126,922 = the General Fund transfer out that the p8 schedule nets against its transfers in. The schedule nets interfund amounts; no detail fix.

Statement p4 Interfund transfer out: General (126,922), Street (16,974), Park (1,011), Total (144,907). Detail transfers out total 17,985 = Street -16,974 (index 20) + Park -1,011 (index 27). The General Fund's 126,922 transfer out is netted into the single p8 Interfund transfers line (16,611 = 143,533 - 126,922, recorded as a net Transfers In, index 13). Gap 144,907 - 17,985 = 126,922. Same netting as the transfers_in gap; no detail fix.
